          {
            "text": "# GUI/CLI接続実装完了",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-11-21 17:00:38",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**タスク**: モックアップ実装のGUIをCLIと本接続するよう修正",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: 2.3.0 (v2.2.0安定版ベース + MCP統合 + GUI-CLI接続)",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 問題解決",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "**元の問題**: GUIがモックアップ実装で、CLIとの接続ができていない",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "**根本原因**:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- GUIのAPIクライアントが &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; の存在しないエンドポイントを呼び出し",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- プロトコルクライアントを使用せず、ハードコードされたモックレスポンスを返却",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLIにRPCサーバー機能が実装されていない",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✅ 実装内容",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. CLIにRPCサーバー機能追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "**追加ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "**新機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "fn launch_server() -&gt; Result&lt;(), Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    // WebSocketベースRPCサーバー（ポート3001）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:3001\").await?;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"RPC Server listening on ws://127.0.0.1:3001\");",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    // ... WebSocket接続処理",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "**依存関係追加**:",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio-tungstenite = \"0.21\"",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "futures-util = \"0.3\"",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "**コマンド追加**:",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "codex server  # RPCサーバー起動",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. GUI APIクライアントの完全書き換え",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "**修正ファイル**: &#96;gui/src/lib/api/client.ts&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "**変更点**:",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- **プロトコル**: HTTP/REST → WebSocket RPC",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "- **接続先**: &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; → &#96;ws://localhost:3001&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- **実装方式**: モックレスポンス → 実際のCLI通信",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "**新アーキテクチャ**:",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "class CodexAPIClient {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  private protocolClient: WebSocket;",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "  private isConnected = false;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "  private requestId = 0;",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "  private pendingRequests = new Map&lt;string, PendingRequest&gt;();",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "  constructor() {",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "    this.initializeConnection(); // WebSocket接続初期化",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  private async sendRequest(method: string, params: any): Promise&lt;any&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {

        ]

          {
            "text": "# GUI/Web Interface",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status**: Experimental | **Version**: 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "ダッシュボードとエージェント管理のためのWebベースGUI。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "CodexのGUIはブラウザベースのインターフェースを提供し、直感的な操作とリアルタイム監視を実現します。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 起動方法",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### 開発サーバー",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# GUIサーバー起動",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "codex gui serve --port=3000",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "# ブラウザでアクセス",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "# http://localhost:3000",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "### Dockerコンテナ",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "# Dockerイメージ使用",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "docker run -p 3000:3000 zapabob/codex-gui:latest",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "# ボリュームマウント",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "docker run -v $(pwd):/workspace -p 3000:3000 zapabob/codex-gui:latest",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎨 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "### ダッシュボード",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Plan Status**: 実行中の計画のリアルタイム監視",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Agent Activity**: サブエージェントの稼働状況",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Performance Metrics**: CPU/メモリ使用率、実行時間",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Log Stream**: 構造化ログのライブ表示",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "### エージェント管理",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Agent Pool**: 利用可能なエージェントの一覧",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Task Assignment**: 手動タスク割り当て",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Performance Tuning**: エージェント設定の調整",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Health Monitoring**: エージェントの健全性チェック",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\docs\\codex_mcp_interface.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "This document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "At a glance:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- Conversations",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- Configuration and info",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;getUserSavedConfig&#96;, &#96;setDefaultModel&#96;, &#96;getUserAgent&#96;, &#96;userInfo&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;model/list&#96; → enumerate available models and reasoning options",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;collaborationMode/list&#96; → enumerate collaboration mode presets (experimental)",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Auth",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;account/read&#96;, &#96;account/login/start&#96;, &#96;account/login/cancel&#96;, &#96;account/logout&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/read&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  - notifications: &#96;account/login/completed&#96;, &#96;account/updated&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/updated&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- Utilities",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;gitDiffToRemote&#96;, &#96;execOneOffCommand&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- Approvals (server → client requests)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;applyPatchApproval&#96;, &#96;execCommandApproval&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- Notifications (server → client)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96;, &#96;authStatusChange&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;codex/event&#96; stream with agent events",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "See code for full type definitions and exact shapes: &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "## Starting the server",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "Run Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client:",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex mcp-server | your_mcp_client",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "For a simple inspection UI, you can also try:",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 47
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3737637400627136
    },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. APIメソッドのRPC対応",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "**主要メソッドの対応表**:",

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "| &#96;login()&#96; | モックレスポンス | &#96;account.login&#96; RPC |",

          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;createConversation()&#96; | モックレスポンス | &#96;conversation.create&#96; RPC |",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;sendMessage()&#96; | モックレスポンス | &#96;conversation.sendMessage&#96; RPC |",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;getAgents()&#96; | デフォルトリスト | &#96;agent.list&#96; RPC |",

          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;runAgent()&#96; | モック実行 | &#96;agent.run&#96; RPC |",

          },

          },

            "text": "| &#96;getSystemMetrics()&#96; | ランダム値 | &#96;system.metrics&#96; RPC |",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. フォールバック機構",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "**接続失敗時の対応**:",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLIサーバーが利用できない場合、モックレスポンスを返却",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "- 開発・テスト環境での利便性確保",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "- 本番環境ではCLIサーバーの起動を前提",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "async getAgents(): Promise&lt;Agent[]&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "  try {",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "## 📋 技術詳細",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "### WebSocket RPCプロトコル",

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "### Web GUI | コントロールセンター",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-gui&#96;（Rust/Axum）を追加し、Codex CLI の主要サブコマンドを HTTP API として公開。",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;gui/frontend&#96;（Node.js/Vite + React）で操作パネルを提供し、Playbook（Ask/Delegate/Research/Review/Audit）をワンクリック実行。",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "- 実行ログ（stdout/stderr/exit code/実行時間）をリアルタイムで可視化し、履歴パネルにスタック。",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;.env&#96;不要で、&#96;CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH&#96; と &#96;VITE_API_URL&#96; により CLI パス/ポートを柔軟に切り替え可能。",
            "lineNumber": 74

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Prism - AI-Native Code Intelligence Platform",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**プロダクト名**: Prism  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: 1.0.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**ライセンス**: Apache 2.0",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "PrismはKamui4d超えの3D/4D Git可視化とマルチLLM対応（OpenAI + Anthropic Claude）を統合した、次世代コードインテリジェンスプラットフォームです。",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🌟 **3D/4D Git可視化**: 50,000コミット@35FPS",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🤖 **マルチLLM対応**: OpenAI GPT-4 + Anthropic Claude 3",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔌 **Claude Code統合**: MCP Server経由",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔐 **完全無料**: Supabase無料枠で構築",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- 💰 **BYOK方式**: ユーザー自身のAPIキー使用",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 クイックスタート",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 前提条件",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- Node.js 18以上",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- npm or pnpm",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- OpenAI APIキー or Anthropic APIキー",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### インストール",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "# Clone repository",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "git clone https://github.com/zapabob/prism-web.git",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "cd prism-web",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "# Install dependencies",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "# Set up environment variables",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "cp .env.example .env.local",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "# Edit .env.local with your Supabase credentials",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "# Run development server",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run dev",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabaseセットアップ",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "1. https://supabase.com でプロジェクト作成",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "2. SQL Editorで &#96;supabase/schema.sql&#96; 実行",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Settings → API から URL と Anon Keyをコピー",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "4. &#96;.env.local&#96; に設定",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://xxx.supabase.co",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=eyJxxx...",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "ENCRYPTION_SECRET=your-32-char-secret-key-here",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📁 プロジェクト構造",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          {
            "text": "# GUI/Web Interface",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status**: Experimental | **Version**: 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "ダッシュボードとエージェント管理のためのWebベースGUI。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "CodexのGUIはブラウザベースのインターフェースを提供し、直感的な操作とリアルタイム監視を実現します。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 起動方法",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### 開発サーバー",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# GUIサーバー起動",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "codex gui serve --port=3000",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "# ブラウザでアクセス",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "# http://localhost:3000",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "### Dockerコンテナ",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "# Dockerイメージ使用",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "docker run -p 3000:3000 zapabob/codex-gui:latest",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "# ボリュームマウント",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "docker run -v $(pwd):/workspace -p 3000:3000 zapabob/codex-gui:latest",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎨 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "### ダッシュボード",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- **Error Patterns**: エラーの傾向分析",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **Success Rates**: タスク完了率の統計",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🛠️ 技術仕様",

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\architecture\\claudecowork-integration.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# ClaudeCowork Integration Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Codexをコアとして、ClaudeCoworkと同等の機能を実装する統合アーキテクチャ設計書。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 調査結果サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### ClaudeCoworkの主要機能（2026年1月調査）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **ファイル・フォルダ管理**",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ダウンロードフォルダの自動整理（種類・日付別）",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "   - プロジェクトファイルの整理（クライアント別）",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 一括リネーム機能",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **ドキュメント作成**",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Excelスプレッドシート（数式対応）",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Word文書（書式設定）",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - PowerPointプレゼンテーション",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **研究・統合**",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "   - ブラウザ拡張機能との統合",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 複数ソースからの情報収集",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 情報の統合と要約",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **タスク処理**",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 複数タスクのキューイング",
